changes.old: Onset: 25:1 opens with the word-event formula, "וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר" (oshb:Ezek.25.1) — the strict 39-form and the any-form 41-count both, carrying no dateline. In the WEB, “Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,” (web:Ezek.25.1). 25:2 supplies the addressee, "בֶּן אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖יךָ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עֲלֵיהֶֽם" (oshb:Ezek.25.2) — the set-your-face command toward the children of Ammon is the book's first foreign addressee, the class shift that opens the oracles-against-the-nations collection. Close (weighed from both sides): 25:7 ends "לָכֵ֡ן הִנְנִי֩ נָטִ֨יתִי אֶת יָדִ֜י עָלֶ֗יךָ וּנְתַתִּ֤יךָֽ לבג לַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְהִכְרַתִּ֨יךָ֙ מִן הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֖יךָ מִן הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת אַשְׁמִ֣ידְךָ֔ וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה" (oshb:Ezek.25.7; לבג there is the verse’s ketiv, Qere לְבַז֙), closing on the 2ms recognition variant "and you shall know that I am YHWH" with a SAMEKH immediately after. An earlier internal close sits at 25:5, "וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת רַבָּה֙ לִנְוֵ֣ה גְמַלִּ֔ים וְאֶת בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן לְמִרְבַּץ צֹ֑אן וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה" (oshb:Ezek.25.5), which also ends on a 2mp recognition-family clause (the wider 2mp recognition family, sweep: 21 verses, includes 25:5, not the strict 2ms list, sweep: 5 verses) and carries its own SAMEKH. Per the standing rule that a refrain closes the unit before it, both 25:5 and 25:7 are treated as closes; they are kept in one row because 25:6 reopens with a coordinating messenger formula ("כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה", oshb:Ezek.25.6) against the same addressee (Ammon) rather than a fresh nation, so no addressee-class shift separates 25:5 from 25:7. Ahead of this row, 25:8 opens a fresh messenger formula with an addressee change to Moab, the row's forward hard seam.
